title: Homogeneous values of the two normalized coefficient composites
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf, $V\in\mathcal C$, and assume module sheafification with locally-bijective compatibility on the site and slice in a containing universe. Let $e$ be any three comparisons of [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-data] satisfying GammaNormalization, LinearNormalization and RestrictionNormalization of [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-normalization]. For every unital $R$-algebra sheaf $A$, slice complex $Q$, base complex $F$, degrees $p+q=n$, $f:W\to V$, $x\in Q^p(W,f)$, $y\in F^q(W)$ and $a,b\in A(W)$, both the left composite and the right composite of that definition send the source generator $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes a$ to the target generator $[(x\otimes a|_V)\otimes(y|_V\otimes1)]_f$. The inverse of the left composite sends $[(x\otimes a|_V)\otimes(y|_V\otimes b)]_f$ to $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes ab$. The left composite is natural in both chain maps through the canonical sourceMap and targetMap of that definition. No equality of chain maps or coefficient-transition coherence is claimed here.

proof.text: Compute the left route: the balanced comparison distributes $a,1$ to the two factors; linear moves $a$ into the extension summand; gamma places the tensor inside that summand. Each step follows the prescribed homogeneous generator equation. Their composition has the first displayed value.

source.place: Tags 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor), 03CY, 03EK and 03EL; agent cochain and coefficient refinement of the indicated steps of lem-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-interchange.

proof.text: Compute the right route: scalar extension of gamma produces $[x\otimes y|_V]_f\otimes a$; linear gives $[(x\otimes y|_V)\otimes a|_V]_f$; the slice balanced comparison distributes $a,1$. RestrictionNormalization identifies its second factor with the restriction of $y\otimes1$. The value equals that of the left route, as a section, without using any global interchange equation.

source.place: Tags 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor), 03CY, 03EK and 03EL; agent cochain and coefficient refinement of the indicated steps of lem-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-interchange.

proof.text: Reverse gamma and linear on the two-scalar target generator, then apply the inverse balanced comparison, which multiplies $a,b$. These give the inverse formula. For naturality, maps of $Q,F$ replace $x,y$ by their images in both composites. The sheafification and tensor universal properties and the coproduct insertions in each total degree detect equality. All equations are chain equations because each constituent is a chain map; all preserve bidegrees.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_composite_values (e : Comparisons.{c, v, r} R V)
    (hg : GammaNormalization.{c, v, r} R V e)
    (hl : LinearNormalization.{c, v, r} R V e)
    (hr : RestrictionNormalization.{c, v, r} R V e) :
    (∀ (A : Under R)
      (Q : Complex.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V)) (F : Complex.{c, v, r} R)
      (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (W : C) (f : W ⟶ V)
      (x : (Q.X p).val.obj (op (Over.mk f))) (y : (F.X q).val.obj (op W))
      (a : A.right.obj.obj (op W)),
      (((e.left R V A Q F).hom.f n).val.app (op W))
          (sourceSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y a) =
        targetSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y a 1) ∧
    (∀ (A : Under R)
      (Q : Complex.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V)) (F : Complex.{c, v, r} R)
      (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (W : C) (f : W ⟶ V)
      (x : (Q.X p).val.obj (op (Over.mk f))) (y : (F.X q).val.obj (op W))
      (a : A.right.obj.obj (op W)),
      (((e.right R V A Q F).hom.f n).val.app (op W))
          (sourceSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y a) =
        targetSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y a 1) ∧
    (∀ (A : Under R)
      (Q : Complex.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V)) (F : Complex.{c, v, r} R)
      (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (W : C) (f : W ⟶ V)
      (x : (Q.X p).val.obj (op (Over.mk f))) (y : (F.X q).val.obj (op W))
      (a b : A.right.obj.obj (op W)),
      (((e.left R V A Q F).inv.f n).val.app (op W))
          (targetSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y a b) =
        sourceSection.{c, v, r} R V A Q F p q n h W f x y (a * b)) ∧
    (∀ (A : Under R)
      (Q Q' : Complex.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V)) (F F' : Complex.{c, v, r} R)
      (u : Q ⟶ Q') (v : F ⟶ F'),
      sourceMap.{c, v, r} R V A u v ≫ (e.left R V A Q' F').hom =
        (e.left R V A Q F).hom ≫ targetMap.{c, v, r} R V A u v)
